calibration.legacy_method: engine-compatible approximation: 1/N current-equity margin, 1x leverage, max N simultaneous positions

data.coverage: 20 instruments; 90-91 complete UTC days; missing source bars were not forward-filled
data.source: OKX public tickers, instruments, daily archives, and funding API

research.calendar_window_definition: last complete UTC calendar days; latest fold exact params; continuous cached history for indicators; flat at window start

cost_model.funding: realized OKX funding at the published timestamp

research.neighbor_rule: unique legal one-step grid neighbors; positive compounded OOS return divided by all unique neighbors, with invalid, flat, and losing neighbors nonpositive

passing_gates.positive_oos_folds: strict majority: at least 2 of exactly 3

research.ranking: overall and passing lists each use OOS daily Sharpe descending, then OOS return descending; overall rank does not imply passing status

warnings: Multiple testing across complete bounded grids can overstate apparent robustness; no multiplicity correction was applied.
The selected universe reflects one current liquidity snapshot and may introduce survivorship and selection bias.
Ninety days and three OOS folds are limited evidence; regime changes, latency, liquidity, and liquidation are not modeled.

Last 30d and 90d use the latest fold exact params. Last 30d overlaps the latest-fold IS by 14 days; last 90d overlaps it by 45 days and also includes history before that IS. These returns are not independent OOS estimates and are start-date sensitive.
Research results are not evidence that a strategy is ready for live trading; independent validation and paper trading are required.
